build_evaluators_from_config: build a list of evaluators from a ml_collections ConfigDict with a predict function and workdir
create_evaluator_base: create an abstract evaluator base class with run, _get_eval_fn, and _setup_dataset methods
run_evaluator: run an evaluator with model parameters and training step to compute metrics over evaluation data
setup_evaluator_dataset: setup an evaluator dataset with batch size, preprocessing, and prefetch configuration
setup_metrics_and_eval_iter: setup metrics collection and evaluation iterator from metrics sequence and predict function
